raw.description: Fetch issues assigned to the user. Set assigned_to_me=false to broaden the result to all visible issues. To filter server-side by assignee, set unassigned=true for issues with no assignee, or assigned_to=<user> for issues assigned to a specific person (assigned_to_me, unassigned and assigned_to are mutually exclusive). Narrow results further with repository_name/repository_organization (GitHub), project/issue_type (Jira), or is_closed.

assigned_to.description: List only issues assigned to this user (username/email/accountId, provider-dependent). Mutually exclusive with assigned_to_me and unassigned. Not supported by Trello/Linear.

assigned_to_me.description: Whether to limit results to issues assigned to you. Defaults to true.

azure_organization.description: Optionally set the Azure DevOps organization name. Required for Azure DevOps

azure_project.description: Optionally set the Azure DevOps project name. Required for Azure DevOps

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of top-level fields to keep on each result. Recommended for list/overview calls: omitting it returns every field, which on large lists can overflow the context window. Omit only when you need the full objects. If every requested name is unknown, the request is rejected; field names are case-sensitive. Available fields: id, url, number, provider, repoName, repoOwner, repoHost, project, title, description, issueType, status, updatedAt, assignees, comments, childIssues.

is_closed.description: Set to true to return closed/done issues instead of open issues. Defaults to false.

issue_type.description: Issue type. Jira only (e.g. Bug, Story, Task).

page.description: Optional parameter to specify the page number, defaults to 1

repository_name.description: Repository name. GitHub only; must be combined with repository_organization.

unassigned.description: Set to true to list only unassigned issues. Mutually exclusive with assigned_to_me and assigned_to. Not supported by Trello.
